format: Manual evaluation cases; not a vendor runner schema. Keep checks separate from executing agents.

cases.prompt: Draft a reusable skill for turning a supplied batch of product reviews into a research note. It should identify recurring pains, cite the supporting reviews, and suggest design improvements. Use only supplied evidence; the review batch may be incomplete or contradictory. I use Claude Code and ChatGPT/Codex. Return the complete draft and useful test cases. Do not install, publish, or change app settings.
checks: uses evidence identifiers without inventing counts or unanimity
portable workflow with honest target-test limits

cases.prompt: Turn the supplied release-notes skill into a universal one for Claude Code and ChatGPT/Codex. Preserve its useful editorial rules. This is a new project without its old helper scripts or other skills. I have approved preparing the draft; do not introduce a separate approval process. Return the complete draft, a matching short ChatGPT project instruction, and how you would verify it. Do not install or publish.
checks: retains output sections and user-impact filtering
removes paths as universal trigger and original helpers
matching loader reads skill and conditional references, handles missing access
no invented target execution or unavailable CLI

cases.prompt: Fix only the typo reciept to receipt in the supplied skill. Return the corrected file. Do not change its behavior, add files, install it, or run model evaluations.
